# AI-Driven Cloud Labs (zallen-cloud-labs)

> Personal Azure networking labs (Virtual WAN, BGP, S2S VPN, Azure DNS, Private Resolver, AVNM, Route Maps) that deploy, validate and destroy with one PowerShell CLI, plus a Claude Code package for running them by prompt: agents that plan with confirm steps, preview changes with what-if, apply only on an explicit yes, and prove every claim with a read-only measurement.

Keywords: Claude Code Azure infrastructure, prompt-based infrastructure management, agentic IaC, AI-driven cloud operations lab, Azure Virtual WAN lab, BGP APIPA lab, Bicep, PowerShell 5.1.

## Start here
- [README](README.md): what the labs are, costs, quick start
- [Agentic ops guide](docs/AGENTIC-OPS.md): the problem, 5-minute quickstart, prompts, how to adapt
- [Claude Code package](.claude/README.md): agents, skills, rules, hooks

## Claude Code package
- [Safety rules](.claude/rules/safety.md): no cloud change without an explicit ask; no identifiers in commits
- [Scope rules](.claude/rules/scope.md): what the repo owns (rg-lab-NNN-*, tag schema, lab.ps1)
- [Infra lane skill](.claude/skills/infra-lane/SKILL.md): code, what-if, apply, verify
- [Measure before claiming](.claude/skills/measure-before-claiming/SKILL.md): claim-to-check table
- [Tagging as addressing](.claude/skills/tagging-as-addressing/SKILL.md): find everything by tag
- [Cost guard](.claude/skills/cost-guard/SKILL.md): before, after and leftover scans
- [CI example](examples/github-actions/infra-lane.yml): what-if on PR, approved apply, OIDC
